description: This file defines the 'Assert' class, which implements an assertion operation within the MiniLang framework of the OFBiz project. It processes <assert> XML elements, evaluates conditions, and logs errors if assertions fail.

classes.name: Assert
classes.description: Implements an assertion operation that evaluates conditions and logs errors if conditions are not met.

classes.name: Assert.AssertFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of Assert from XML elements.

methods.name: Assert
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Assert object by parsing XML element attributes and child elements.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the assertion logic, checking conditions and recording error messages if assertions fail.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Assert object, including its conditions.
